significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) conclusion that a token’s measurable "convergence depth" predictively couples semantic role and late-layer causal necessity: "connective/filler/restating tokens" converge earlier and tolerate skipping, whereas "genuine deduction tokens" continue changing and require deeper computation. This establishes both a phenomenon—role-ordered depth requirements—and a computational mechanism that predicts which unseen CoT tokens can safely omit layers, a sharper constraint than the generic confidence-based adaptive-depth premise used by CALM (Schuster et al., 2022) or token-routing premise of Mixture-of-Depths (Raposo et al., 2024). Verified false is also determinate and informative: it would rule out stable early logits as a reliable proxy for required reasoning depth and undermine the proposed semantic depth taxonomy, although it would not rule out adaptive depth based on other signals. Topic substitution fails: replacing this predictive coupling with the generic topic of efficient, interpretable reasoning would not warrant this score, because the role ordering and convergence-to-dispensability relation are the claim-specific increment.

reach.justification: The named handle is "convergence depth," operationalized as "early-layer prediction stability," together with a "training-free per-token depth-allocation controller" that skips remaining layers after shallow convergence. It is ex ante at the per-token level—the signal fires before the remaining layers execute and therefore creates an immediate action window—and could be used by inference-system practitioners rather than only by researchers conducting post-hoc analysis. Although thresholds may require per-model calibration, the claimed role ordering and coupling between convergence and safe layer omission predict what re-extraction should recover across CoT tasks and reasoning models; the absolute layer index, by contrast, is not promised to transfer. Topic substitution again fails: efficient reasoning alone supplies neither this deployable online signal nor its semantic interpretation, so the reach comes from the claim-specific predictor and intervention rather than the topic’s general importance.
